experiment.name: hook-contention
experiment.hypothesis: bounded CPU/I/O contention is associated with a larger upper-tail change than median change
experiment.design: idle bookends with balanced direct/shell and measurement order inside each segment
limitations: Single-host exploratory run; ratios are not causal estimates.
Load segments are sequential and may retain temporal bias.
Synthetic load does not represent every Agent workload.
Load averages are descriptive and respond slowly to segment changes.

gate.name: healthy bounded load with lossless silent delivery
